work: Design and Security Validation of Image-Agnostic Visual Semantic Authentication (VSA) Framework Based on Vision-Language Model
year_venue_status: 2026; Journal of The Korea Institute of Information Security and Cryptology 36(3), 935-948; peer-reviewed/KCI; DOI 10.13089/JKIISC.2026.36.3.935
problem: Image-independent visual-semantic authentication from a reference image; authentication with an arbitrary policy-satisfying image plus password
representation: Grounding DINO + CLIP; 22 object categories; predefined attributes; quantities; visibility; 2x2 quadrant location; canonical category/core-concept/position/visibility/feature/count tokens
matching: User selects 2-3 facts and quantity operators; Flexible Range Logic (==, >=, <=, >, <); AND; 16 policies across five difficulty levels
privacy_mechanism: SHA-256 binds category/concept/location/visibility/attribute with the password; quantity/operator target metadata remains separate; described as server-opaque and explicitly weaker than strict zero knowledge
threat_model_or_attacks: Shoulder surfing, image leakage, brute force, server compromise, replay, and VLM adversarial inputs are discussed. Evaluation uses 1,009 negative images (mostly COCO), policy FAR/FRR and Clopper-Pearson intervals; no K0-K3, partial-information, AI-assisted, linkage, inversion, or adaptive-oracle evaluation
offline_attack_property: Paper acknowledges limited semantic input space and billions of SHA-256 trials/second; recommends Argon2id plus a user-specific random salt. This raises guess cost but does not establish private matching or offline-oracle resistance under compromise
approximate_matching: Yes; user-selected rules and quantity ranges
main_limitation_relative_to_project: Positive FRR images are automatically selected from cached detections rather than independently regenerated/re-inferred; no participant study; Semantic Relationship Logic is future work; policy privacy, unlinkability, domain separation, private evaluation, model drift, and full acceptance-region attacks are absent
relation_to_project: Closest mandatory baseline split into semantic-policy component and full semantic-plus-password architecture. It defeats first-semantic/image-independent/VLM/canonical-token/flexible-policy claims; candidate gap is the combined v2 reconstruction, system-derived typed policy, budgeted attacks, and private/unlinkable verification
verification_note: Complete 16-page local paper reviewed and visually checked on 2026-08-25; bibliographic identity also cross-checked against Korea's official national knowledge portal

approximate_matching: No image-generation or VLM tolerance; semantic linkage is encoded by token selection/placement

relation_to_project: Prior semantic graphical authentication; blocks broad first-semantic-story/graphical-password claims. Human results cannot transfer to this no-human-study project
